blind.action: A calm bearded man in white and red speaks to three frightened men in a boat. The other men huddle together and wonder aloud who he is, while the water around the boat appears calm.
blind.story_guess: This appears to illustrate the Bible story of Jesus calming the storm. The exact moment shown is after the wind and sea have obeyed him, when Jesus asks why the disciples were afraid and they wonder who he is.

Wer ist denn dieser, dass auch der Wind und der See ihm gehorchen?
